summary: Batch program that sequentially reads the indexed CARD master file (CARDFILE) and displays every card record. A simple browse/report utility: open the file, loop reading and displaying each record until end-of-file, then close. Any I/O error prints the file status and abends.

paragraphs.name: MAIN-PARA
paragraphs.pseudocode: Announce start of CBACT02C. Open the card file. Loop until end-of-file: read the next card record and, while not at end-of-file, display it. When done, close the card file, announce end of execution, and return to the caller.
paragraphs.notes: Driver paragraph; sequential read-and-display loop over the card master.

paragraphs.name: 1000-CARDFILE-GET-NEXT
paragraphs.pseudocode: Read the next card record into CARD-RECORD. If the read succeeded (status '00') set result OK. If status is '10' set end-of-file (16); any other status is an error (12). Then: if OK continue; if end-of-file mark END-OF-FILE = 'Y'; otherwise report the read error, save the status and abend.
branches: IF APPL-AOK ... ELSE IF APPL-EOF ... ELSE (abend)
paragraphs.notes: Uses status-code 88-levels APPL-AOK (0) and APPL-EOF (16) as control flags.

paragraphs.name: 0000-CARDFILE-OPEN
paragraphs.pseudocode: Open the card file for input. If status '00' set result OK, else error (12). If OK continue; otherwise print an open error, save the status and abend.

paragraphs.name: 9000-CARDFILE-CLOSE
paragraphs.pseudocode: Close the card file. If status '00' clear the result to OK, else set error (12). If OK continue; otherwise print a close error, save the status and abend.

paragraphs.name: 9999-ABEND-PROGRAM
paragraphs.pseudocode: Print 'ABENDING PROGRAM', set timing to 0 and abend code to 999, and call the system routine CEE3ABD to terminate the job abnormally.

paragraphs.name: 9910-DISPLAY-IO-STATUS
paragraphs.pseudocode: Format and display the file status code. If non-numeric or its first byte is '9', decode the second byte as binary and show a 4-digit value; otherwise show the two-digit status right-justified in a 4-digit field.
branches: IF IO-STATUS NOT NUMERIC OR IO-STAT1 = '9' ... ELSE
paragraphs.notes: Generic file-status display helper; handles VSAM extended (9nn) status codes.
